Class ClientCredentials

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.iam.client.ClientCredentials
@Entity public class ClientCredentials extends Object
Represents the client credentials for authentication purposes. Contains information such as the client ID, password hash, failed login attempts, and the timestamp of the last login.
